caption:
His father is from Kerala. His mother is from Ukraine. In July 2026, he launched to the International Space Station.

NASA astronaut Anil Menon launched on his first spaceflight aboard Soyuz MS-29 on July 14, 2026, from Baikonur Cosmodrome, for an approximately 8-month mission. Before becoming an astronaut, Menon spent years as a NASA flight surgeon and was SpaceX's first flight surgeon and medical director - he's also a colonel in the US Space Force and an emergency medicine physician. He was born in Minneapolis to a father who immigrated from Ottapalam, in Kerala's Palakkad district, and a mother who immigrated from Ukraine.

A flight surgeon who treated astronauts for years is now one himself, 250 miles above Earth.

Sources: NASA.gov, Space.com (2026)
